verdict.rationale: Marqeta's documentation pages are served with .md extensions (e.g., cards.md, introduction.md) which is agent-friendly, but explicit llms.txt and aggregated docs.md endpoints both return 404, so there is no standard machine-discoverable entry point for agents. missing for 10: a working llms.txt file, an aggregated docs.md index, and confirmation that individual .md pages are consistently available across the whole doc site.
